source.title: Anyone else not getting any extra materials from Dragonflight disenchanting crafted items?

quote: around 600 Enchanted Writhebark Wand and never recived a reasonant crystal
notes: Firsthand report of approximately 600 wands disenchanted and zero Resonant Crystals, post-Dragonflight during The War Within (reported Nov 2024). Sample size is approximate: casts=null, not exactly 600. Unknown gear quality/bonus variant, skill profile details, current patch at processing time, actual live wand disenchant eligibility and other output yields. The speaker also mentioned about 8,000 unspecified Dragonflight leatherworking bracers but gave no per-material totals, so they are NOT a second quantifiable output cohort. TSM item listing independently identifies Enchanted Writhebark Wand as item 200641 (https://tradeskillmaster.com/retail/us/items/200641). Do not pool this historical/post-expansion zero-crystal observation with Dragonflight-release drop baselines or interpret zero as other materials absent.
stats: TWW profession tools possible; unclear whether equipped
